price_snapshot.source_selection: Together provider row, listed uncached input and output prices; not the cheapest-provider headline or weighted average.
price_snapshot.basis: API-equivalent estimate for the same named model at another provider; not a Verda tariff or GPU hardware cost.
price_snapshot.verda_tariff_note: No published per-token rate was found for the supplied custom Junction deployment during this check.
price_snapshot.effective_cost_basis: Project owner reports effectively free access. No billing account was queried.
assumptions: All reported prompt tokens, including image tokens, use the uncached input rate.
Completion tokens include any billed reasoning tokens; do not add reasoning tokens again.
Caching discounts, separate image charges, taxes and provider-specific adjustments are excluded.
The estimate covers the saved successful response's usage, not unknown failed-attempt charges or local preprocessing.
